Author: Sordel
Montan
Title: Meraveill me com negus honratz bars
FullText: Meraveill me com negus honratz bars,
Montan, diz be, si nol fai eissamen,
qen loc del dir deu esser le chalars,
qan taing qel faitz veingna primieramen;
em meraveill com hom, ses cor datendre,
pot prometre; qe fals prometres fa
cel qui promet per mensongier reprendre,
part lavol crim qe lengan len atrai.
meraveilla, en Sordel, no men pren:
tant es granz fais era prez e donars,
qe cor no pot far boca ver dicen;
mas avols hom sen cuia aisi defendre
ab gen mentir; pero el sen dechai:
qals entendenz non pot hom far entendre
qe ben estei aisso qe mal estai.
